build_list_tools: list all auto-discovered tools and filter by input policy trusted, untrusted, or blocked
get_tool_policy_options: get available input and output policy options with descriptions for tool trust management
get_tool_detail: get a single tool's details including its policy overrides for UI detail view
update_tool_policy: set input or output policy for a tool globally or create per-team or per-key overrides
get_tool_usage_logs: get paginated usage logs for a tool filtered by date range with snippet extraction
